offering_description.value: Designs and supplies replacement automotive and heavy-duty truck parts under its own brands and store brands, sold to aftermarket retailers and distributors that serve vehicle repair shops and do-it-yourself customers.

primary_products.value: brake parts; electrical and sensor parts; engine and fuel system parts; wheel hub bearings; heavy-duty truck parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: automotive aftermarket retailers, warehouse distributors, online retailers, and repair shop suppliers

revenue_model.value: product sales: replacement parts sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets parts made by contract manufacturers, sold to aftermarket retailers and distributors

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada, and Mexico, with smaller sales in Europe and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: automotive replacement parts and heavy-duty truck parts sold to the same aftermarket channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to national and regional aftermarket chains and distributors; online: sales through e-commerce retailers and marketplaces

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: emissions-related parts subject to EPA and California CARB rules, plus product safety and import rules
